product: Marg ERP 9+ (desktop ERP; also sold as Marg Cloud hosting, plus a separate cloud product MargBooks)
vendor: Marg ERP Ltd (margcompusoft.com; MargBooks at margbooks.com)

facts.claim: Marg has a dedicated 'Mobile Shop Billing Software' page aimed at mobile phone shops, accessory dealers and mobile distributors.

Marg's own site says 50% of India's pharma and FMCG businesses run on Marg ERP; its retail product page and add-ons (PharmaNXT, prescription reminders, Pass Ki Dukan, medical insurance) are heavily pharmacy-oriented.

Marg ERP 9+ India prices (licence, 18% GST extra): Nano Rs 5,550 (max 2 users, max 2 companies); Basic Rs 10,300 (Limited Edition, 1 user full rights, max 2 users); Silver Rs 13,900 (1 full-rights user + 1 view-only user); Gold Rs 26,000 (unlimited users, unlimited extra companies). Extra users/companies Rs 3,000 each on Nano/Basic/Silver.

Annual 'ARC' charges (18% GST extra) are listed separately: Nano Rs 2,400, Basic Rs 3,990, Silver Rs 4,780, Gold Rs 9,550 (up to 25 users/25 companies) or Rs 19,100 (unlimited); additional user ARC Rs 1,050, extra company ARC Rs 1,030. Listed inclusions: 'License fee & upgradation for 1 year', 2 troubleshooting visits, second free view-only user, free phone support from local support centres.
Marg states 'Final Prices vary on customer requirements and implementation basis', 'Customisation extra', and that it does not sell through online portals (no support if bought there).

Marg Cloud (hosted Marg ERP) costs the ERP licence plus Rs 7,500 + GST per year (Marg Cloud) or Rs 10,800 + GST per year (Premium) per user; Dedicated VPC is Rs 45,000 per month + GST. Price list examples: Basic Cloud Rs 17,800, Silver Cloud Rs 21,400 (18% GST extra).

Separate cloud product MargBooks is billed annually per organisation (GST exclusive): Gold Rs 5,400 (1 user, 1 GSTIN, 5,000 invoices), Diamond Rs 8,100 (1 user, 12,000 invoices), Platinum Rs 15,300 (2 users, 30,000 invoices), Platinum Plus Rs 29,700 (2 users, 2 GSTIN, 1 lakh invoices); Enterprise (Head Office, Warehouse, Multi Branch) is 'Contact Us'. Extra invoices Rs 0.80 each. MargBooks offers a free trial.
The mobile-shop POS page still shows an older price block (Rs 9,999 / Rs 13,500 / Rs 25,200), which differs from the main price list.

IMEI and serial number tracking is marketed as built in: 'Every handset is tracked by its IMEI and serial number from the moment it enters stock', used to identify the unit for warranty claims or returns.
Marg's help docs describe an IMEI-wise Sale report (Daily Reports > Inventory Reports > IMEI wise Sale), filterable by party, company, item and IMEI, exportable to Excel.
MargBooks mobile-store page lists 'Serial Number/IMEI Number Wise Billing' with per-serial sales history.
Marg ERP has free-scheme/bonus features: party-wise, item and batch-wise, quantity and amount schemes with automatic free-quantity calculation, plus group-wise scheme management.
The mobile-shop page says ERP-to-ERP ordering lets the retailer see a supplier's live stock, rates and 'active schemes' when placing purchase orders.
The mobile-shop page lists 'Warranty Management': warranty information is documented at purchase. No warranty-claim workflow with brands or service centres is described.
Marg says mobile retail chains can manage inventory across branches and lists multi-branch management for mobile shops.
Stock is moved between stores/branches through a Stock Issue / Stock Transfer entry (Transactions > Stock Issue > New).
Marg's download page offers a separate 'Branch Sync Patch' and 'Corporate Sync Patch', which suggests branches running the desktop product are synced through add-on patches.
The eOwner mobile app shows reports branch-wise and can merge trial balance, balance sheet and P&L for chain stores.
In MargBooks, Multi Branch / Branch Master / Head Office / Warehouse is listed only under the Enterprise ('Contact Us') plan.
Marg supports GST billing, GST returns filed from the software, TCS/TDS, e-way bills generated and uploaded directly, and e-invoice upload to the IRP.

Full accounting up to balance sheet: ledgers, trial balance, P&L, balance sheet, bank reconciliation (140+ banks), cost centres and budgets, and 1,000+ reports. Marg markets itself as 'Accounting more easy than Tally'.
Receivables features include outstanding reports, ageing analysis, payment reminders, credit limits and temporary credit limits, and post-dated cheque management.
Customer loyalty points and discounts are offered for mobile shops.
Invoices can be sent over WhatsApp/SMS as a PDF with a 'Pay Now' link, and outstanding balances and reports can be sent to customers by WhatsApp, SMS or email.
Automatic WhatsApp reminders on the retail page are pharmacy-focused (bill, promise-order and prescription reminders).
MargMart lets a business create its own e-commerce website 'in just 5 minutes for only Rs 10,000'.
The mobile-shop page mentions e-commerce integration to keep inventory in sync for shops that also sell online; it does not name specific marketplaces.
Marg ERP 9+ is downloadable, installed software (download page, version updated 05-Aug-2026, patches for GST, WhatsApp, branch sync and more); auto cloud backup goes to Google Drive or OneDrive.

With Marg Cloud, data is stored only on the cloud and 'Local and cloud data cannot be mixed or synchronized directly'; it can be accessed from desktops, laptops, tablets and smartphones with an internet connection.

Companion mobile apps include eOwner (cloud-linked owner dashboard for sales, stock, outstanding, P&L), eRetail, eOrder and eDelivery; eOwner is priced separately at Rs 4,100 (1 owner), Rs 5,550 (2) or Rs 10,250 (5) per year + 18% GST.
Deep compliance and accounting in one package (GST returns, e-invoice, e-way bill, TDS/TCS, balance sheet, bank reconciliation) with 2,500+ configuration options and custom invoice formats.
ERP-to-ERP ordering lets retailers order straight into a distributor's Marg system, and purchase bills can be imported from Excel/CSV or photo/PDF. This is strongest where suppliers also use Marg.
One-time licence model: the Gold edition gives unlimited users for Rs 26,000 + GST plus annual ARC, which can cost less than per-user subscriptions for larger teams.

Marg claims 10+ lakh users, 1 million+ businesses served, 850+ sales and support centres, 8,500+ sales and service professionals, 250+ support staff, 500+ tutorial videos, and operation since 2000; local support centres help with setup.
Marg provides Tally/Busy import/export patches, which helps migration from Tally or Busy.

not_found: Repair / service job cards for handset repairs: not found. Mobile-shop pages mention 'Karigar, Approval, Sale Order, Repair ... Reports' in copy that looks reused from jewellery pages, and 'Repair Data Base' in MargBooks is a data-repair utility. There is no service-job workflow.

Brand/dealer scheme claims, cashback or sell-out incentive tracking against manufacturers (e.g. Samsung/Vivo schemes): not found. Only generic free-scheme/discount features and a supplier-side sale-scheme register were found.
Warranty claim workflow with brands or service centres: not found (only 'warranty info documented at purchase').
Branch-wise price lists in Marg ERP 9+: not found on pages read (MargBooks retail chain page mentions standard/promotional pricing across stores).
Explicit free trial length or free plan for Marg ERP 9+: not found ('Start your free trial' button on mobile pages; download is free, but no terms were stated). MargBooks advertises a free trial.
What stops working if ARC is not renewed: not found (help FAQ only says a 'Warranty Overdue' alert appears).
Offline behaviour of Marg Cloud: not found. Desktop Marg ERP 9+ is installed locally, but the site does not explicitly say it works offline.
Consumer-finance/EMI provider integrations (Bajaj, HDFC etc.): not found; only 'EMI' is listed as a payment mode.
Independent market-share data for Indian mobile/electronics retail: not found. Only Marg's own claims were found (50% of pharma & FMCG).
notes: Two different products share the Marg brand: Marg ERP 9+ (Windows desktop licence plus annual ARC, optionally hosted as 'Marg Cloud') and MargBooks (a separate browser/app cloud subscription with different plans and features). Make clear which one a comparison refers to. margcompusoft.com failed TLS certificate verification in WebFetch, so its pages were read with curl -k on 28 Sep 2026; care.margcompusoft.com was read through WebFetch. Marg's mobile-shop pages (pos-software-for-mobile-shop, mobile-shop-invoicing-software) are templated and contain pharmacy/jewellery copy (prescription reminders, Karigar, Pharmacy Chain merge), and the retail-chain MargBooks page mentions 'medicines'. Treat feature lists there as generic and not specific to mobile shops. Price blocks conflict: the main price list shows Rs 10,300/13,900/26,000 while the mobile POS page shows Rs 9,999/13,500/25,200, so use marg-price-list.html. The ARC interpretation (annual renewal covering licence and upgrades) is based on the 'License fee & upgradation for 1 year' line and is marked medium confidence. The IMEI-wise sale help article is filed under 'Automobile'/mobile-setup queries but applies to general IMEI tracking. Third-party claims (e.g. AMC at 25-35%/yr from aidukan.in) were NOT used.
